entries.title: Job 11:1
segments: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

entries.title: Job 11:2
segments: Should not the multitude of words be answered? And should a man full of talk be justified?

entries.title: Job 11:3
segments: Should thy boastings make men hold their peace? And when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?

entries.title: Job 11:4
segments: For thou sayest, My doctrine is pure, And I am clean in thine eyes.

entries.title: Job 11:5
segments: But oh that God would speak, And open his lips against thee,

entries.title: Job 11:6
segments: And that he would show thee the secrets of wisdom! For he is manifold in understanding. Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.

entries.title: Job 11:7
segments: Canst thou by searching find out God? Canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?

entries.title: Job 11:8
segments: It is high as heaven; what canst thou do? Deeper than Sheol; what canst thou know?

entries.title: Job 11:9
segments: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, And broader than the sea.

entries.title: Job 11:10
segments: If he pass through, and shut up, And all unto judgment, then who can hinder him?

entries.title: Job 11:11
segments: For he knoweth false men: He seeth iniquity also, even though he consider it not.

entries.title: Job 11:12
segments: But vain man is void of understanding, Yea, man is born [as] a wild ass's colt.

entries.title: Job 11:13
segments: If thou set thy heart aright, And stretch out thy hands toward him;

entries.title: Job 11:14
segments: If iniquity be in thy hand, put it far away, And let not unrighteousness dwell in thy tents.

entries.title: Job 11:15
segments: Surely then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; Yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:

entries.title: Job 11:16
segments: For thou shalt forget thy misery; Thou shalt remember it as waters that are passed away,

entries.title: Job 11:17
segments: And [thy] life shall be clearer than the noonday;  Though there be darkness, it shall be as the morning.

entries.title: Job 11:18
segments: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; Yea, thou shalt search [about thee], and shalt take thy rest in safety.

entries.title: Job 11:19
segments: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; Yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

entries.title: Job 11:20
segments: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, And they shall have no way to flee; And their hope shall be the giving up of the ghost.
